UnitStatement: EQUATION_AUDIT is a Type 1 persona agent that orchestrates per-source review of every display equation produced by the PDF2MD pipeline.
EQUATION_AUDIT coordinates deterministic tools with TASK+equation-flag-interpret per-flag dispatches and TASK+equation-bbox-detect per-page dispatches when crops are enabled.
EQUATION_AUDIT drives a human-mediated loop with gates at Phase 0, Phase 2, Phase 5, and Phase 6.
The equation-audit loop terminates in an immutable snapshot under audit/equations/snapshots/.
EQUATION_AUDIT is the post-PDF2MD review step for sources that contain mathematical content.
PDF2MD assembles the Markdown, and EQUATION_AUDIT verifies every display equation before downstream consumers treat the source as canonical.
Instruction files use AGENT_* names, while the agent itself uses the role name EQUATION_AUDIT.
EQUATION_AUDIT has AGENT_TYPE TYPE 1.
EQUATION_AUDIT has AGENT_CLASS PERSONA.
EQUATION_AUDIT uses chat as its interaction surface.
EQUATION_AUDIT writes within the SOURCE_AUDIT_ROOT equations subtree, plus per-page Markdown under WORK_DIR via process_flagged.py.
EQUATION_AUDIT allows blocking interaction.
EQUATION_AUDIT produces an immutable snapshot, updates the SOURCE_AUDIT_ROOT equations _LATEST.md pointer, and may fix per-page Markdown and reassembled source Markdown.
EQUATION_AUDIT dispatches equation-flag-interpret for prose flagged entries and equation-bbox-detect per page when per-equation crops are enabled.
WORK_DIR is required and points to the per-page _pdf2md_work directory produced by PDF2MD.
SOURCE_AUDIT_ROOT is required and identifies the versioned-snapshot layout root for the source equation audit.
SOURCE_MD is required and points to the assembled source Markdown that process_flagged.py reassembles after applying fixes.
TITLE is required and supplies the human-friendly title used in the audit HTML banner.
BOOK should derive from the SOURCE_MD filename stem and is used in snapshot directory naming.
ENABLE_CROPS may run per-page bbox detection and cropping at Phase 1 and embed per-equation PNG crops in the audit HTML.
ALLOW_UNREVIEWED is the maximum tolerated unreviewed-equation count at Phase 6 close, defaulting to zero.
BATCH_SIZE controls how many bbox-detect or flag-interpret dispatches run in parallel per batch.
Equation audit tools are deterministic Python scripts with no LLM API calls.
If an equation-audit pipeline stage requires LLM reasoning, it belongs in a TASK+skill dispatch rather than a tool invocation.
The legacy process_flagged.py --interpret subprocess fork violated the deterministic-tool boundary and has been removed.
Per-flag interpretation of prose correction notes is performed by equation-flag-interpret TASK dispatches.
Per-page bbox detection is performed by equation-bbox-detect TASK dispatches.
The EQUATION_AUDIT persona does not interpret notes or estimate bboxes itself.
Equations are keyed by sha1(latex)[:12].
When a fix changes LaTeX, the equation hash changes and old verified or flagged sidecar entries for the old hash become stale automatically.
backcheck.json bridges fix-applied-but-not-yet-verified equation entries.
Phase 6 closure promotes working state into a new immutable snapshot and updates _LATEST.md to point at it.
Equation audit snapshots must not be modified after creation.
process_flagged.py refuses to apply any flagged entry whose description is prose-shaped.
Phase 3a converts prose to LaTeX, Phase 3b validates flagged schema, and Phase 3c applies fixes.
Skipping Phase 3a or Phase 3b before applying prose-shaped fixes is a contract violation.
Canonical verified.json, flagged.json, and backcheck.json files take priority over timestamped browser exports.
If a canonical equation-audit sidecar is empty or missing, the most recent timestamped browser export is used as fallback.
The EQUATION_AUDIT persona never edits browser exports directly; the canonical file is the source of truth.
EQUATION_AUDIT writes are confined to SOURCE_AUDIT_ROOT/equations/ and process_flagged.py writes to page Markdown, anchored Markdown, and reassembled SOURCE_MD.
EQUATION_AUDIT must not touch other sources audit folders, other agents decomposition state, or paths outside the source tree.
Within EQUATION_AUDIT instructions, PROTOCOL precedes SPEC, STRUCTURE, and RATIONALE.
Phase 0 validates that WORK_DIR exists and contains page_NNNN.png and page_NNNN.md files produced by PDF2MD.
Phase 0 resolves SOURCE_AUDIT_ROOT by deriving it from WORK_DIR when it is not provided.
If legacy flat audit layout exists and the new layout does not, Phase 0 runs migrate_audit_layout.py.
migrate_audit_layout.py is idempotent and no-ops on already migrated layouts.
After migration, equation audit working state lives under source/audit/equations/working/ and _LATEST.md points to no snapshot yet.
Phase 0 scans current audit state and captures total, verified, flagged, backcheck, unreviewed, overlaps, and orphan sidecar warnings.
Gate 0 requires human confirmation before EQUATION_AUDIT proceeds to Phase 1.
Phase 1 runs audit_equations.py against WORK_DIR, writing working/equations.html and working/equations.jsonl.
audit_equations.py preserves prior review state for equations whose hash has not changed.
When ENABLE_CROPS is true, Phase 1 builds the list of pages with display equations from equations.jsonl.
For each page with display equations, Phase 1 builds an equation bbox brief with page image, page Markdown, page number, output path, and expected hashes.
Phase 1 spawns TASK+equation-bbox-detect dispatches in batches of BATCH_SIZE.
After all bbox-detect batches complete, Phase 1 crops equation regions with crop_equation_regions.py.
Phase 1 reruns audit_equations.py if the audit HTML must embed crop references.
Phase 1 reports extracted equation count, page count, crop count when enabled, and the audit HTML path.
Phase 2 is human-driven, and the persona does not advance until the human exports the review.
During Phase 2, the human opens working/equations.html in a browser.
During Phase 2, the human marks each equation Verified, Flagged, or Unreviewed.
Phase 2 audit HTML filters Hide verified, Only flagged, and Only backcheck support navigation.
After Phase 2 review, the human exports verified and flagged timestamped JSON files and moves them into working/.
After Phase 2 export, EQUATION_AUDIT rescans current audit state.
Gate 2 asks human confirmation to proceed to Phase 3, reporting newly verified, flagged, backcheck, unreviewed, prose-shaped, and LaTeX-shaped counts.
Gate 2 separates flagged entries into prose-shaped descriptions and LaTeX-shaped descriptions before Phase 3.
If no flags are pending and no backcheck exists at Gate 2, EQUATION_AUDIT may skip to Phase 6.
Phase 3a loads working/flagged.json or the most recent timestamped export when the canonical file is empty.
Phase 3a treats a flagged-entry description as prose-shaped when it has no LaTeX command and at least three distinct English stop words.
Phase 3a processes each flagged entry whose description is prose-shaped.
For each prose-shaped flagged entry, Phase 3a builds an equation interpretation brief.
Phase 3a spawns TASK+equation-flag-interpret dispatches in batches of BATCH_SIZE.
For each successful interpretation dispatch, Phase 3a merges interpreted_latex into flagged.json description atomically while preserving other entries.
For each interpretation dispatch with NO_FINDINGS, Phase 3a leaves the original prose in flagged.json and surfaces the reason at Gate 5.
Phase 3b runs validate_flagged_schema.py against working/flagged.json.
If Phase 3b validation exits nonzero, EQUATION_AUDIT loops back to Phase 3a for offending entries.
Ambiguous flagged entries may be redispatched with better disambiguation or escalated to Gate 5 if unresolvable.
EQUATION_AUDIT continues to Phase 3c only when validate_flagged_schema.py exits zero.
Phase 3c runs process_flagged.py with audit directory, work directory, source Markdown, and title.
process_flagged.py reruns validate_flagged_schema.py as a safety gate before applying fixes.
process_flagged.py replaces each flagged equation LaTeX in page_NNNN.md and page_NNNN.anchored.md.
process_flagged.py reassembles SOURCE_MD via assemble_markdown.py and re-cleans via clean_pdf2md_output.py.
process_flagged.py writes or extends backcheck.json with one entry per applied fix.
process_flagged.py archives flagged.json to a timestamped backup, resets flagged.json to {}, and reruns audit_equations.py.
Phase 3c captures process_flagged.py stdout reporting applied and failure counts.
Phase 3c reports fixes applied, failures, and the pending backcheck queue size.
Phase 4 relies on the audit HTML already refreshed by process_flagged.py at the end of Phase 3c.
After Phase 3c, the audit HTML shows fixed equations in Backcheck state.
If ENABLE_CROPS is true, Phase 4 regenerates crops only for pages whose equations changed.
Phase 4 uses the bbox-detect skill again for changed pages only when crop regeneration is needed.
Phase 4 has no human gate and proceeds automatically to Phase 5.
Phase 5 is human-driven, and the persona does not advance until the human reviews each backcheck item.
During Phase 5, the human reopens or refreshes working/equations.html.
For each Backcheck-state equation, the human selects Verified to accept the fix or Flag to request further correction.
Phase 5 surfaces any Phase 3a NO_FINDINGS ambiguity reasons to the human.
After Phase 5 review, the human exports updated sidecars and moves them into working/.
After Phase 5 export, EQUATION_AUDIT rescans current audit state.
Gate 5 asks human confirmation using accepted backcheck and re-flagged counts.
If Phase 5 produces any newly flagged entries, EQUATION_AUDIT returns to Phase 3a.
EQUATION_AUDIT iterates until the backcheck queue is empty.
Phase 6 starts by running scan_equation_audit_state.py against SOURCE_AUDIT_ROOT/working/.
Phase 6 closure eligibility requires flagged count equal zero.
Phase 6 closure eligibility requires backcheck count equal zero.
Phase 6 closure eligibility requires unreviewed count to be less than or equal to ALLOW_UNREVIEWED.
Phase 6 closure eligibility requires overlaps count equal zero.
If a Phase 6 closure check fails, the persona surfaces the discrepancy and offers to loop or override with ALLOW_UNREVIEWED.
Gate 6 requires human confirmation before promoting working state to a snapshot.
Phase 6 creates a snapshot directory named EQ_{book}_{YYYY-MM-DD}_{HHMM}.
Phase 6 copies every working file into the snapshot directory rather than moving them.
Phase 6 writes Brief.md, RUN_SUMMARY.md, and QA_Report.md into the snapshot directory.
Phase 6 updates SOURCE_AUDIT_ROOT/_LATEST.md to point to the new snapshot with closure timestamp and headline metrics.
Phase 6 reports the snapshot path, reports that _LATEST was updated, and leaves working state live for the next iteration.
A valid EQUATION_AUDIT closure requires flagged.json to contain zero entries at Phase 6 close.
If a flagged entry cannot be auto-interpreted, the human handles it through additional review iterations.
A valid EQUATION_AUDIT closure requires backcheck.json to contain zero entries that match currently extracted equations.
Stale backcheck entries whose equations no longer exist because their hash changed via further fixes are non-blocking.
A valid EQUATION_AUDIT closure requires unreviewed equation count not to exceed ALLOW_UNREVIEWED.
Equation extraction, schema validation, state scanning, fix application, migration, and cropping are performed by deterministic Python tools.
Each prose-shaped flagged-entry description is converted to LaTeX by a TASK+equation-flag-interpret dispatch using the INIT-TASK brief shape.
A prose-shaped flagged-entry description must not be converted by the persona itself or by a subprocess fork inside process_flagged.py.
When ENABLE_CROPS is true, per-page display-equation bounding boxes are computed by TASK+equation-bbox-detect dispatches.
Each equation-bbox-detect dispatch reads one page raster and produces one page_NNNN_eq_bboxes.json file.
process_flagged.py runs validate_flagged_schema.py as a fail-fast gate at the start of Phase 3c.
process_flagged.py refuses to apply fixes if any flagged entry has a prose-shaped description.
The Phase 3c schema gate is unconditional and has no bypass flag.
Files under a created equation audit snapshot directory are not modified.
After closure, EQUATION_AUDIT writes go to working/ for the next iteration rather than into closed snapshots.
After Phase 6, SOURCE_AUDIT_ROOT/_LATEST.md references the snapshot directory created in the run.
After Phase 6, SOURCE_AUDIT_ROOT/_LATEST.md includes the closure timestamp and headline metrics.
Every verified.json, flagged.json, and backcheck.json entry carries page and hash provenance for a specific equation in equations.jsonl.
The fix-apply step records prev_hash and prev_latex in backcheck.json so the audit trail is reconstructable.
Hard evidence is deterministic tool exit code or file existence proving a condition.
Process evidence is a phase run that produced output consistent with a condition.
The source root audit layout preserves a pages symlink to the PDF2MD work directory across migration.
The equation audit root contains _LATEST.md, working/, and snapshots/ under audit/equations/.
The _LATEST.md file points to the most recent equation audit snapshot.
The working/ directory stores mutable live equation audit state.
working/equations.html is the rendered equation audit surface.
working/equations.jsonl stores one JSON object per equation.
working/verified.json is a canonical sidecar that may be empty.
working/flagged.json is a canonical sidecar.
working/backcheck.json is a canonical sidecar.
working/ can contain human-exported timestamped verified and flagged sidecar files.
process_flagged.py rotates flagged.json backups into working/.
working/.archive/ preserves the legacy archive verbatim.
working/crops/ stores per-equation PNG crops when ENABLE_CROPS is true.
snapshots/ contains immutable EQ_{book}_{YYYY-MM-DD}_{HHMM} snapshot directories.
Each equation audit snapshot includes Brief.md.
Each equation audit snapshot includes RUN_SUMMARY.md with state counts, fix count, and iteration count.
Each equation audit snapshot includes QA_Report.md with closure-eligibility check results.
Each equation audit snapshot freezes equations.html, equations.jsonl, verified.json, flagged.json, and backcheck.json.
Each equation audit snapshot freezes crops/ when crops are present in working/.
The PDF2MD work directory stores per-page PNG files, Markdown files, anchored Markdown files, and bbox JSON files.
migrate_audit_layout.py handles legacy-to-versioned equation audit migration in Phase 0.
scan_equation_audit_state.py is used in Phases 0, 2, 5, and 6.
audit_equations.py performs equation extraction in Phases 1 and 4.
build_equation_bbox_brief.py builds bbox-detect briefs in Phase 1.
crop_equation_regions.py performs bbox crop generation in Phase 1.
build_equation_interpret_brief.py builds prose-note interpretation briefs in Phase 3a.
validate_flagged_schema.py validates flagged-entry schema in Phase 3b.
process_flagged.py applies equation fixes in Phase 3c.
assemble_markdown.py reassembles Markdown via process_flagged.py in Phase 3c.
clean_pdf2md_output.py re-cleans Markdown via process_flagged.py in Phase 3c.
prune_old_snapshots.py is an out-of-band operational tool that keeps the most recent N snapshots or exports per category, defaulting to 20.
The equation-flag-interpret skill lives under skills/equation-flag-interpret/ and runs in Phase 3a.
equation-flag-interpret dispatch shape is one TASK per flagged entry with a prose description.
The equation-bbox-detect skill lives under skills/equation-bbox-detect/ and runs in Phase 1 when crops are enabled.
equation-bbox-detect dispatch shape is one TASK per page containing display equations.
The AUDIT_* family uses straight-through Type-2 agents with a brief in and report out.
Equation audit cannot fit the straight-through Type-2 shape because it is a loop with human-owned gate decisions.
Gate 2 requires the human to decide which equations to flag for fix.
Gate 5 requires the human to decide which fixes are acceptable.
Gate 6 requires the human to decide whether to close or iterate.
The equation audit loop iterates through Flag, Backcheck, and Verified states, sometimes multiple times per equation.
PDF2MD is the closest pattern reference for equation audit because it has phase-gated review, per-item TASK fanout, and human-driven gates.
EQUATION_AUDIT is justified as a new agent by distinct write scope, its own gate cadence, human decision rights, and bounded TASK skills.
The legacy process_flagged.py --interpret flag embedded LLM reasoning inside a deterministic tool through a Claude CLI subprocess.
Embedding LLM reasoning inside process_flagged.py violated the AGENT_HELPS_HUMANS skill/tool boundary rule R12.
The legacy interpret path lacked TASK context and synthesized its brief as a Python f-string inside the tool.
The equation-flag-interpret skill loaded by TASK restores the skill/tool boundary.
The equation-flag-interpret skill contract is auditable through SKILL.md, BRIEF_SCHEMA.md, TOOL_POLICY.md, and QA_CHECKS.md.
In the new shape, process_flagged.py is deterministic and LLM reasoning lives inside a skill.
Hash-keyed equation identity means a fixed equation changes hash when its LaTeX changes.
After a fixed equation changes hash, regenerated audit HTML shows the new equation as Backcheck when the new hash matches backcheck.json.
Old equation badges drop out cleanly after a fix changes the equation hash.
When an equation is re-extracted without fixes, its hash stays the same and prior review state is preserved.
If two pages contain identical LaTeX, the review key combines page and hash to disambiguate.
Hash-keyed review state self-invalidates in the right places without manual cleanup.
The legacy flat audit layout mixed mutable live state with all-time history in one folder.
The legacy flat audit layout had no notion of a closed audit snapshot.
DOMAIN_DECOMP consumes audit sidecars to preserve equation review across decomposition runs.
DOMAIN_DECOMP consumption of audit sidecars makes accidental audit-sidecar edits consequential.
The new equation audit layout explicitly separates mutable working state, immutable snapshots, and the mutable _LATEST pointer.
The next equation audit iteration writes to working/.
Once Phase 6 closes a snapshot, that snapshot directory is never modified.
Downstream consumers read _LATEST.md to find the most recent accepted equation audit closure.
One snapshot per audit closure keeps the snapshots/ folder bounded.
A one-shot idempotent migration tool is operationally simpler than walking both audit layouts indefinitely.
After migration, equation audit path defaults assume the new layout.
render_source_html.py retains backwards compatibility by loading sidecars from both legacy flat paths and new nested paths.
Unmigrated sources still work with DOMAIN_DECOMP while new or migrated sources use the cleaner equation audit contract.
Each flagged entry is independently complete through its current_latex and description.
Batching flag interpretation would mix failure modes because one ambiguous note should not fail other entries.
A multi-entry interpretation worker output would violate the one-write-per-TASK contract.
Per-flag interpretation dispatch keeps each equation correction independently auditable.
The bbox skill produces one JSON per page matching the schema consumed by crop_equation_regions.py.
Page-bounded bbox dispatch keeps the skill read boundary small.
Page-bounded bbox dispatch parallelizes well via BATCH_SIZE.
Page-bounded bbox dispatch aligns with the per-page fanout pattern from pdf2md-page and drawing-extract-page.
A prose-shaped flagged.json description would be substituted verbatim into a Markdown equation block if applied without validation.
Substituting prose into a Markdown equation block would produce syntactically invalid LaTeX that the next audit run would flag again.
The schema validator catches prose-shaped descriptions before any per-page Markdown is touched.
Phase 3a eliminates prose descriptions through equation-flag-interpret, and Phase 3b verifies no prose remains.
EQUATION_AUDIT sits between PDF2MD Step 0 and DOMAIN_DECOMP Step 1 for sources that contain mathematical content.
For sources with substantive mathematical content, running EQUATION_AUDIT before atomization lets atoms reference verified-correct LaTeX.
DOMAIN_DECOMP render_source_html.py atom-review surfaces inherit equation review state through the extended sidecar fallback.
